title: Which Plant Mom Energy Are You?
description: Are you a chill succulent mom or a chaotic tropical plant lady? Find out your true plant parent personality!

chill.title: The Chill Plant Mom
chill.description: You take a laid-back approach to plant parenting. Your plants thrive on good vibes and occasional neglect. You're the friend who says 'plants just need love' and somehow has the most resilient pothos.

chaotic.title: The Chaotic Plant Lady
chaotic.description: Your plant collection is growing faster than you can count. You have too many plants and not enough windows. You water things when you remember and yet somehow... they keep multiplying. Living for the plant train.

nurturing.title: The Nurturing Plant Mom
nurturing.description: You treat your plants like your children. Each one has a name, a story, and a personalized care routine. Your plants are thriving because they have the most devoted parent in the world.

minimalist.title: The Minimalist Plant Parent
minimalist.description: Less is more for you. A few well-chosen plants in chic containers bring you more joy than a jungle. You value quality over quantity and know exactly what works in your space.

practical.title: The Practical Plant Parent
practical.description: You do your research, follow the rules, and keep things simple. Snake plants and ZZ plants are your best friends. Low maintenance is the way to go, and your black thumb is officially green.

dreamer.title: The Aspiring Plant Dreamer
dreamer.description: You don't have plants yet, but oh, you want them. Your Pinterest is 90% plant inspo and you've already named your future monstera. One day, you'll have your dream jungle.
